_about: USD per million tokens. Keys are the model id exactly as it appears in Claude Code transcripts (message.model). A model or token class without a price makes the cost come out as unknown, never estimated.
_source: Anthropic first-party API rates as listed in the claude-api reference bundled with Claude Code (price table cached 2026-11-03). Check https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing before publishing any number.
_cache_write_multipliers: When a model has no explicit cache_write_5m / cache_write_1h, the script derives them from input: 5-minute write = 1.25x input, 1-hour write = 2x input. Cache read differs by model and is never derived.

claude-haiku-5-5._note: cache read price not listed in the bundled reference; sessions with cache reads on this model report cost as unknown
